dialogue.content: (時間になったら始めますね。よろしくお願いします）
dialogue.English: (We'll start when it's time. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.content: （よろしくおねがいいたします。ご希望のクライエントの設定はございますか？）
dialogue.English: (Thank you. Do you have any preferences for the client's profile?)

dialogue.content: （お任せいたします）
dialogue.English: (I'll leave it up to you.)

dialogue.content: （承知しました。）
dialogue.English: (Understood.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。よろしかったら初めに、性別と年齢を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor. To begin, if you're comfortable with it, could you please tell me your gender and age?

dialogue.content: 女性、30歳です。
dialogue.English: I'm a 30-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 子育てのことで相談に来ました。
dialogue.English: I've come here to talk about some issues with child-rearing.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 子育てのことでお悩みなんですね
dialogue.English: So, you're having some concerns about child-rearing, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。少し詳しく聞かせていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Could you tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.content: 三か月前に出産したのですが、とても大変で辛いです。
dialogue.English: I gave birth three months ago, and it's been very difficult and overwhelming.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか...おつらい状況なんですね
dialogue.English: I see... It sounds like a very difficult situation for you.

dialogue.content: 体調はいかがですか？
dialogue.English: How are you feeling physically?

dialogue.content: 睡眠やお食事はとれてますか？
dialogue.English: Are you able to get enough sleep and eat properly?

dialogue.content: 睡眠もあまりとれていなくて、食事もままならない感じです。
dialogue.English: I'm not getting much sleep, and I can barely manage to eat properly.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね..それは休まらなくてしんどいですね
dialogue.English: I see... It must be exhausting not being able to get any rest.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: お手伝いしてもらえる人はどんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone who can help you?

dialogue.content: お手伝いしてくれる人とはだれか？ということですか？
dialogue.English: Do you mean, who is there that can help me?

dialogue.content: そうですね、どなたかいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, is there anyone?

dialogue.content: そういう意味なら、特にいません。
dialogue.English: In that sense, not really, no one in particular.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 産後の体も回復しない時期だと思うのですが..
dialogue.English: And this is a time when your body is still recovering from childbirth...

dialogue.content: お一人でやりくりしているんですね
dialogue.English: So, you're managing everything on your own.

dialogue.content: それは...大変つらく感じてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: That must feel very overwhelming.

dialogue.content: はい、私の親はひとり親で仕事をしておりますし、主人の両親も遠方で病気を抱えているので、里帰りはしませんでした。
dialogue.English: Yes. My parent is a single parent and works, and my husband’s parents live far away and have health issues, so I didn’t return to my parents’ home for support after the birth.

dialogue.content: そうですね、全部ひとりという状況なので、つらいですね。
dialogue.English: That's right, I’m doing everything by myself, so it’s tough.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね...一番大変な生後3か月という時期をよく頑張っていらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.English: I see... You're working so hard through what is often the most challenging period, the first three months after birth.

dialogue.content: お話に来てくれてありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming to talk with me today.

dialogue.content: 頑張るのも疲れました。
dialogue.English: I'm just tired of trying so hard.

dialogue.content: そうですよね...
dialogue.English: I can understand that...

dialogue.content: もっともだと思います
dialogue.English: That's completely understandable.

dialogue.content: あなたのお気持ちはどなたかにお話ししていますか？
dialogue.English: Have you been able to talk to anyone about how you're feeling?

dialogue.content: 主人が帰宅すれば多少は話しますが、他の人に話す機会はないです。
dialogue.English: I talk a little with my husband when he gets home, but I don't have the opportunity to talk to anyone else.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか..夫さんはなんとおっしゃっていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. What does your husband say?

dialogue.content: 大変だね、とか、休めるときに休んで、とか言葉での労わりはあります。
dialogue.English: He offers words of support, like, "That must be tough," or "Rest when you can."

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 一番大変なのは、どんなことだとお考えですか？
dialogue.English: What do you feel is the most difficult part for you?

dialogue.content: 寝れないことだと思います。
dialogue.English: I think it's the lack of sleep.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。３時間おきの授乳は永遠に続くループのように感じますよね..
dialogue.English: I see. The every-three-hour feedings can feel like a never-ending cycle, can't they?

dialogue.content: 眠れないですよね
dialogue.English: It makes it so hard to sleep, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、授乳の間もぐずっている時が多くて、休めないです。
dialogue.English: Yes. The baby is often fussy even between feedings, so I can’t get any rest.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 疲れますよね
dialogue.English: That must be exhausting.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: It is.

dialogue.content: 毎日どんなお気持ちで過ごしていますか？
dialogue.English: How are you feeling day to day?

dialogue.content: いつかたっぷり寝れる日が来るのかなとか、ゆっくり食事をしたのはいつが最後だろうとか、時間の感覚もなくなりつつありますね。
dialogue.English: I find myself wondering if a day will ever come when I can get enough sleep, or thinking about the last time I had a relaxed meal. I'm starting to lose my sense of time.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか..そうですね、時間の感覚もなくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I see... Yes, you really do lose your sense of time, don't you?

dialogue.content: 悲しくなったり、ご自分を責めたり、されてないですか？
dialogue.English: Do you find yourself feeling sad, or blaming yourself at all?

dialogue.content: 悲しいとか、責めるとかっていう感情はないですね。
dialogue.English: I don't really have feelings like sadness or self-blame.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは少し安心しました
dialogue.English: I see. I'm a little relieved to hear that.

dialogue.content: （電波が悪くすみません）
dialogue.English: (Sorry, my connection is a bit unstable.)

dialogue.content: （いえ、大丈夫ですよ）
dialogue.English: (No, it's fine.)

dialogue.content: 今一番、どうしていきたいと思っていますか？
dialogue.English: Right now, what would you most like to see happen?

dialogue.content: どうしたら、この状況を乗り切れるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How can I get through this situation?

dialogue.content: そうですね...今の状況を何とか乗り越えたいですよね
dialogue.English: Right... you want to find a way to get through this situation, don't you?

dialogue.content: 眠れない、ゆっくり食事もままならない状況...でしょうか？
dialogue.English: This situation of not being able to sleep or eat properly... is that what you mean?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうですね。ご一緒に考えましょうね
dialogue.English: Okay. Let's think about this together.

dialogue.content: ちょっとお話を整理してもいいですか？
dialogue.English: May I take a moment to summarize what you've told me?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ３か月前に出産されて、睡眠も食事もままならない生活が続いていて、つらい。親御さんを頼ることも、夫さんにもお話はしているけれど、ワンオペでやっていて、とにかく大変。いつか眠れるようになるのか、ゆっくり食事をしたのはいつだろうとか、考える日が続いていて、何とか乗り越えたくて相談に来てくれた
dialogue.English: You gave birth three months ago, and you're struggling because you haven't been able to sleep or eat properly. You aren't able to rely on your parents, and while you do talk to your husband, you're handling everything by yourself, which is incredibly difficult. You spend your days wondering if you'll ever be able to sleep again or when you last had a relaxed meal, and you came here today hoping to find a way to get through it.

dialogue.content: といった感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: Does that sound about right?

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 私も経験がありますけれど...
dialogue.English: I have experience with this myself, as well...

dialogue.content: 初めての出産の後のつらさは、いいようがないほどですよね
dialogue.English: The difficulty after a first childbirth is just beyond words, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 思い描いていた明るくて幸せな毎日とは程遠くて
dialogue.English: It's a far cry from the bright, happy days you might have imagined.

dialogue.content: 私は毎日泣いていました
dialogue.English: I cried every day.

dialogue.content: 大変だったんですね。
dialogue.English: That must have been very hard for you.

dialogue.content: そうですね。私は相談者さんのように頑張れなくて
dialogue.English: Yes, it was. I wasn't able to manage as well as you are.

dialogue.content: 毎日夫に八つ当たりしてしまいました
dialogue.English: I took it out on my husband every day.

dialogue.content: なので、相談者さんは、本当に立派だと思います
dialogue.English: So, I think you are truly doing an amazing job.

dialogue.content: きっと、家族思いで、責任感があるんですね
dialogue.English: You must be very considerate of your family and have a strong sense of responsibility.

dialogue.content: 素晴らしいです
dialogue.English: That's wonderful.

dialogue.content: 私も主人にあたりたい気持ちになります。ただ、主人も精一杯やっていることがわかるので、何とも言えない気持ちになります。
dialogue.English: I also feel like lashing out at my husband. But I know he's doing his best too, so I'm left with this indescribable feeling.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね...悩ましいですよね
dialogue.English: I see... That's a difficult position to be in, isn't it?

dialogue.content: お気遣いされる方なだけに
dialogue.English: Especially since you're such a considerate person.

dialogue.content: 相談員の方のように、言えたらいいのですが私はそれがうらやましいです。
dialogue.English: I wish I could just say it like you did. I'm envious of that.

dialogue.content: いえいえ、悪い見本なので..
dialogue.English: Oh no, I'm a bad example...

dialogue.content: きっと皆さんのお気持ちに配慮される方なだけに
dialogue.English: Because you are someone who is so considerate of everyone's feelings,

dialogue.content: ストレスもたまりすぎてしまうのかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: perhaps you're accumulating too much stress.

dialogue.content: 少し私が感じたことをお話してもいいでしょうか
dialogue.English: Would it be okay if I shared a thought?

dialogue.content: 自分ではよく分からないのですが、そうなのかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: I'm not sure myself, but that might be the case.

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 例えば、相談者さんは自治体の子育てに関するサポート体制があるのはご存じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: For example, are you aware of the child-rearing support systems offered by your local municipality?

dialogue.content: ファミサポとかでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you mean something like the Family Support program?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.content: ご利用は検討されてないですか？
dialogue.English: Have you considered using them?

dialogue.content: 今は毎日の生活でいっぱいいっぱいで、それを検討する気力もありませんでした。
dialogue.English: Right now, I'm just so overwhelmed with daily life that I haven't had the energy to even consider it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 一日数時間預かってもらいながら
dialogue.English: Even just having someone look after your baby for a few hours a day,

dialogue.content: ゆっくりお風呂やお昼寝、気分転換に使うのも、ずいぶん助けられるかもしれないと思いますが
dialogue.English: so you could take a relaxed bath, take a nap, or do something for a change of pace, might be a big help.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: それから、保健所の保健士さんに育児相談することで..
dialogue.English: Also, by consulting a public health nurse at the public health center about child-rearing...

dialogue.content: 本当にそれが出来るのなら、とてもありがたいと思いますがまずは連絡をして、面談をして…という段階を踏むことよりもその時間があるなら、少しでも休みたいというのが本音です。
dialogue.English: If that were really possible, I would be very grateful, but honestly, if I have the time it would take to go through the steps of contacting them and having an interview... I'd rather use that time to rest, even for a little bit.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: それくらい疲れていらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.English: You're that exhausted.

dialogue.content: もっともですよね
dialogue.English: That makes perfect sense.

dialogue.content: さき程、夫さんも精いっぱいなので、というお話がありましたが..
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that your husband is also doing his best...

dialogue.content: LINEをしている暇があるなら、とお思いでしょうが今もおんぶしながら、家の中を歩き回りながらご相談している状況です。
dialogue.English: You might be thinking, "If she has time to be on a messaging app," but I'm actually talking to you now while walking around the house with my baby on my back.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 授乳中もぐずっているとおっしゃっていましたよね
dialogue.English: You mentioned the baby is fussy even between feedings, right?

dialogue.content: ずっと、だっこかおんぶをしているご状況でしょうか
dialogue.English: So, are you constantly holding or carrying the baby on your back?

dialogue.content: そうですね、布団に置くと泣き出すので、時間によっては近所迷惑になってしまいます。ようやく首がすわってきたので、おんぶできるようになって、両手が使えるので、少し楽になりました。
dialogue.English: Yes. The baby starts crying if I put them down, and depending on the time of day, it could bother the neighbors. Their neck has finally gotten strong enough that I can carry them on my back, and having both my hands free has made things a little easier.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: これも、電話連絡をしなくてはいけないことは変わりないのですが...
dialogue.English: This would also require you to make a phone call, but...

dialogue.content: 子ども家庭支援センターに一度家庭訪問をしてもらうことはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How about having someone from the Child and Family Support Center make a home visit?

dialogue.content: コカセン、あまりいいイメージがないのですが…
dialogue.English: The Child and Family Support Center... I don't have a very good impression of it, to be honest.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか..それは躊躇しますよね
dialogue.English: I see... That would make you hesitate, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: なにもしないよりは、マシかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: I suppose it might be better than doing nothing.

dialogue.content: そうですね...それと、夫さんに、じっくりご相談してみることはできそうでしょうか
dialogue.English: I see... Also, do you think it might be possible to have a thorough talk with your husband?

dialogue.content: 年度末まで繁忙期なので、難しいと思いますがそれを乗り切ったら、話してみたいと思います。
dialogue.English: It's his busy season until the end of the fiscal year, so it's difficult right now, but I'd like to talk to him once he gets through that.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日お話をしながら感じたことですが...あなたは気づかいをする方なので、もしかしたら、夫さんとお話しすることでお気持ちは少しかるくなるのではないかと
dialogue.English: This is just something I felt as we were talking today... you're a very considerate person, so perhaps talking things over with your husband might lighten your emotional load a little.

dialogue.content: 思いましたが..いかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: That was my thought... what do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね。時期を見て、話したいと思います。
dialogue.English: You're right. I'll find the right time to talk to him.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: よろしかったら、またお話ししに来ていただけたら、その時々で、いろいろな方法をご一緒に考えたいと思います
dialogue.English: If you'd like, please feel free to come back and talk again. We can explore different options together as things change.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。その時はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. I'd appreciate that.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ今日はお話に来てくれてありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well for coming to talk with me today.

dialogue.content: 今日はいったん終了してもよろしいでしょうか?
dialogue.English: Shall we end our session for today?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: あなたの子育てを応援しています。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: I'm cheering for you on your parenting journey. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （電波が悪くまどろこしくてすみませんでした。今日のロープレ終了してもよろしいでしょうか）
dialogue.English: (I apologize if the poor connection was frustrating. May we end today's role-play?)

dialogue.content: （はい、終了して大丈夫です。電波は気になりませんでしたよ。）
dialogue.English: (Yes, it's fine to end. The connection didn't bother me at all.)

dialogue.content: （勉強になりました。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (This was a great learning experience. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: （また機会がありましたら、よろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (I look forward to working with you again if we have the opportunity.)
